items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability leading to Unauthenticated Customer Account Takeover
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to switch a customer session to another customer account, gaining access to the victim's account and private data. It has a CVSS score of 9.1 and is being actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A high-severity stored XSS vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: This high-severity stored XSS vulnerability could lead to arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability leading to Security Feature Bypass (Adobe Commerce B2B)
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B that could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability leading to Security Feature Bypass

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability leading to Security Feature Bypass

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability leading to Privilege Escalation
